Vendored upstream sources
=========================

The pure-Python packages in this directory are unmodified copies of the
corresponding sources from the FunPay Cardinal project:

    https://github.com/sidor0912/FunPayCardinal

  FunPayAPI/   FunPay API client used by Cardinal plugins
  Utils/       Cardinal helper utilities
  locales/     Cardinal localization
  tg_bot/      Cardinal Telegram helpers (CBT/text constants only)

License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (as published by the upstream project).
These files are bundled only so the extension's embedded Python (Pyodide)
runtime can import the real FunPayAPI/Utils/locales instead of stubs.

To refresh them, re-download the paths listed in manifest.json from the
upstream repository (default branch: main).
